verdict.rationale: Jitsu documents a public Management API with a 'full OpenAPI 3.0 reference' at docs.jitsu.com/api, implying some interactive spec exists, but there's no evidence of runnable/try-it-out examples, and a probe for openapi.json/swagger.json at standard paths returned 404s, casting doubt on discoverability. Missing for 10: confirmation of an interactive Swagger/Redoc-style UI, runnable code samples, or hands-on corroboration that the API reference supports live example execution.
